QuestInfo.name: Traces of Nick
QuestInfo.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter
QuestInfo.0: I should go see Scadur the Hunter in El Nath.
QuestInfo.1: Scadur has not heard from his son and wants you to find #bNick's Ring#k. He thinks it may be in Ice Valley somewhere. It sounds like a rigorous adventure awaits you!\r\n\r\nTip: A rumor has it that the #bPiece of Statue#k is in #r#m211040400##k.
QuestInfo.2: You found a Piece of Statue on Sharp Cliff II.

0.0: I had an adorable son who meant the world to me. His name was #bNick#k. Although he was just an ordinary boy to everyone else, he was my good and faithful son.
0.1: When the monsters from the Dead Mine attacked the town, I lost my wife Lia. Nick became a completely different person after that. The doctors told me this was a normal response to being 'sad'.
0.2: Nick wanted to be strong enough to defeat the monsters that took his mother. I approved completely, but he left 3 years ago to train and never returned. I'm starting to worry a bit.
0.3: The thing is, he took a really nice ring with him when he left. I'd love to get that back if I could. There is a #bPiece of Statue#k somewhere in Ice Valley. You may be able to find his ring somewhere near there.
0.4: Please find his #bring#k for me. Also, in honor of my son's noble sacrifice, please take down the #bYetis#k and collect #b80 #t4000049##k items for his memory. I have faith in you.\r\nI will send you straight to Ice Valley II. That place is directly connected to the Dead Mine. Good luck.

no.0: I understand. You must be worn out from all that traveling... but if you want to change your mind, then please come talk to me. I can't think of anyone else but you that can do this.

npc.0: Haven't you found #bNick's Ring#k? I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in Ice Valley... Some people saw the Piece of Statue in #r#m211040400##k. Go check out that area.

item.0: There seems to be a little bit of room below #b#p2030007##k, but no matter how much I look into it, I can't find anything in there.
